notes: Professor notes specify 980 available nodes, 16 processors per node and 256000 memory per node.
The PM100 column num_nodes_req is treated as requested processors, despite the misleading name.
The total processor capacity is therefore 980 * 16 = 15680.
A job can run if, for every occupied slot, used_processors + job.num_nodes_req <= 15680.
Under normal PM100 submission frequency the system is rarely close to saturation; capacity can be considered effectively non-limiting for many experiments.
Memory is documented here but is not yet a hard scheduling constraint.
